gen-gf-offside-gf-armata: Armata lays out its rounded letters with generous gaps, while Offside, the display heading, spaces itself wide with curves left open. Over a long page, that body feels like an easy, unhurried walk.
gen-gf-offside-gf-athiti: Cut-vinyl lettering, stretched wide and left open. Offside carries a commanding look, and Athiti's high mean line and see-through s keep the sans-serif text friendly beneath it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible stays crisp and approachable. Beneath it, Offside's wide-tracked heading has no tapering at all, so a long stretch of text keeps a steady, open pace.
gen-gf-offside-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-: Curves that never quite close define Offside, a heading drawn with pencil-line consistency. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono counters with clipped capitals and stretched-open spacing, so the sans text breathes where the heading commands.
gen-gf-offside-gf-biryani: Offside spreads its wide-tracked, open-curved heading across the top, level and commanding, while Biryani underneath draws a big clear eye on each e. Long text stays unclogged and friendly.
gen-gf-offside-gf-blinker: Open curves, wide tracking and a level beat mark Offside as a heading that commands attention, with Blinker's lowercase filling its height below. Strokes stay uniform throughout.
gen-gf-offside-gf-carrois-gothic: Wide, open and unshaded. Offside is happiest announcing things in strokes with no thick or thin parts, while Carrois Gothic, a sans-serif with a high x-height, does the quiet work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-offside-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC reads in a friendly, open way, with capitals and lowercase nearly matched in height, and Offside's unmodulated, widely tracked heading gives it a confident lead-in. That unmodulated lettering is what makes the pairing so cohesive.
gen-gf-offside-gf-chivo: Offside's curves refuse to close, and its widely tracked letters show no difference between upstrokes and side strokes. Chivo's sans-serif lowercase, packed up toward the caps, suits a body size a notch smaller.
gen-gf-offside-gf-chocolate-classical-sa: Commanding from the first line, Offside pulls its strokes smooth like solder through a nozzle, and Chocolate Classical Sans follows with a large lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke. A long page would read easily.
